verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a dedicated Vendors module in its data library, with documented pages for vendor risk assessment, sending and reviewing security questionnaires, and vendor data APIs. The AI Systems module adds vendor due-diligence workflows (reviewing vendor security posture, requesting documents, tracking submissions), though only for AI vendors. The evidence for general vendors is mostly page titles, so the depth of inventorying and of the data-access and cadence elements is unproven. Missing for 10: documented general vendor inventory fields, tracking of vendor data access, scheduled review cadence or reassessment reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
